resolution.provenance: Decided by the main instance after delegation by the operator on 2026-09-22; revisable.
resolution.basis: The publication is its own work, an adaptation with a change of medium: page 4916 credits it as a graphic novel by its illustrator, adapted into German by a second person; the illustrator's author page 5110 lists the French graphic novel of 2015 and this edition under the heading German translation; page 675 lists the French graphic novel of 2015 as freely inspired by the Schachnovelle. The German edition of 2016 translates the French graphic novel of 2015 and leaves the editions of the Schachnovelle.
